messages:
priya@pegasus: hey team — looking to onboard a private reranker model for Pegasus Insights. need it behind our VPC, HSM for keys, and strict PHI redaction. timeline: hoping to go live in ~6 weeks. can you confirm what info you need to start?

anna.cs: thanks Priya — we can take this. quick Qs: is the model customer-owned or provided by Redwood? also do you need Dedicated (reserved GPUs) or Private (VPC/on‑prem)?

priya@pegasus: model is customer-owned — a fine-tuned 7B reranker built on an open checkpoint. we'll host model artifacts in our S3 with cross-account access. want Redwood Private (VPC) + HSM for keys.

sam.solutions: +1 on VPC+HSM. for CS kickoff we'll need: 1) model artifact location & manifest 2) sample eval set (50-200 queries) 3) failure/latency SLOs 4) privacy checklist (PHI fields list). can you share a minimal sample set now?

priya@pegasus: attaching a small sample here (sanitized). note: labels are internal relevance scores 0-3. we also have a small held-out PHI redaction test corpus.

ethan.eng: thanks. engineering notes: preferred model format = gguf/ggml or torch.pt with a tokenizer.json. if using quantization we need to know target bits. also what's your expected peak qps and max sequence length?

priya@pegasus: artifact is a torch.pt (hf compatible), tokenizer.json included. planning int8 quantization. expected peak qps ~50, 2k tokens max seq.

anna.cs: uploading onboarding task to tracker and scheduling a 30m kickoff tomorrow. we'll run an initial compatibility check and a safety eval pass on the PHI test corpus.

opsbot: Ticket created: CS-5421 — "Pegasus Insights private reranker intake". Assignees: anna.cs, sam.solutions, ethan.eng. Due date: 2026-04-10.

sam.solutions: for evals we can run a small reranking harness — we'll compute NDCG@10, rerank delta vs baseline, and run rollback checks for hallucination. sample command for our harness:```bash
python eval_reranker.py --model s3://pegasus/models/reranker.pt --queries sample.json --out results.json
```

ethan.eng: infra questions: do you require dedicated GPUs (Reserved) for consistent p95 latency? If so we'll propose Dedicated with autoscale burst for spikes. Otherwise hosted Private can autoscale but with looser latency SLO.

priya@pegasus: Dedicated preferred — latency is critical for our product. also need audit logs and token-level cost breakdowns for internal chargeback.

anna.cs: noted. renewal/contract note: flagged as "high-touch" enterprise — success here could increase committed spend. we'll map enablement sessions and quantify business metrics for renewal health.

sam.solutions: next steps: 1) Priya to share S3 manifest + IAM role 2) Pegasus to provide PHI redaction spec 3) Redwood to run compatibility + eval (ETA 72h after artifacts) 4) kickoff meeting link sent. can we confirm a time tomorrow 10-10:30 PT?

priya@pegasus: yes 10am PT works. thanks all — excited to get this moving.

anna.cs: booked. I'll drop the invite and pre-read checklist. tagging @ethan.eng for infra prep. :rocket:
